title: Simpson's paradox: exercise, age, and cholesterol
content: Age affects both exercise and cholesterol, confounding the pooled exercise-cholesterol trend. Age-stratified data support a beneficial exercise effect after adjustment for Age.

variables.name: Age
variables.content: The confounder affecting exercise and cholesterol.

variables.name: Exercise
variables.content: Weekly exercise, the exposure whose effect is sought.

arrows.because: The source states that older people in the population exercise more.
The source identifies a possible causal effect of Age on Cholesterol.
The age-stratified trend is interpreted as a beneficial exercise effect.
